entries.to: About Harbor Mind | Licensed Therapists in Miami

entries.prefix: Founded to close the gap between what patients need
entries.to: Meet the licensed therapists behind Harbor Mind, our story since 2016, and the way we work with every client in Miami and online.

entries.prefix: Founded in 2016 to close the gap
entries.to: Harbor Mind opened in 2016 to make therapy in Miami easier to start and easier to stay with. Meet our therapists, our story and the way we work.

entries.prefix: We are a team of passionate, purpose-driven
entries.to: We’re a team of licensed therapists in Miami who believe everyone deserves a calm place to land.

entries.prefix: Our quest to improve one life
entries.to: Our promise to one client became a way of caring for everyone

entries.prefix: The gap between what people in need actually require
entries.to: Harbor Mind began with a simple frustration: people who finally worked up the courage to ask for help were met with long waitlists, rushed sessions and care that never quite fit. We built the practice we wished existed, where you can start within days, see the same therapist every week, and move at a pace that feels right.

entries.prefix: See what we've been up to
Check out our latest news, announcements, and updates on our YouTube
entries.to: Find calming tips, therapist Q&As and practice news on our Instagram.
Dr. Elena Marquez opens Harbor Mind in a two-room Brickell office with one promise: no one should wait months to be heard.

entries.prefix: The FDA grants Breakthrough Therapy Designation
entries.to: Daniel Reyes, LMFT, joins to lead our couples and family work, using Gottman-informed and emotionally focused methods.

entries.prefix: The urgent, unmet need in TRD calls us to act
entries.to: We add EMDR and trauma-focused CBT, so clients carrying trauma can heal at a pace that feels safe.

entries.prefix: We complete our IPO on the Nasdaq
entries.to: We launch secure online sessions across Florida, so busy parents, shift workers and students can get care from wherever they are.
We move into a light-filled office in Brickell with soundproofed rooms, soft lighting and a quiet waiting area.
Care for teens and young adults
Natalie Cruz, LMHC, starts our teen and young adult program, with family check-ins built into every plan.

entries.prefix: Recognizing the urgent need for PTSD patients
entries.to: We open sessions until 8pm on weekdays and on Saturday mornings, because life doesn’t stop at five o’clock.

entries.prefix: Results from our Phase 2b trial in TRD are published
entries.to: Every client can now track progress with short, research-backed check-ins, so we can see together what’s working.
We start small therapy groups for grief, new parents and social anxiety, each led by a licensed clinician.

entries.prefix: Results from our Phase 2 open-label study in PTSD
entries.to: We set aside sliding-scale spots every week, so cost is never the only reason someone goes without care.

entries.prefix: First pivotal data in a new category
COMP360 becomes the first classic psychedelic to report
entries.to: Every service is now offered in English and Spanish, so more Miami families can be heard in the language they think in.

entries.prefix: Our second Phase 3 trial in TRD
entries.to: Our team passes ten thousand sessions with clients across Miami-Dade and Florida, and the first session still starts with your story.

entries.prefix: The FDA accepts our Investigational New Drug
entries.to: We welcome new clinicians and open more same-week consults, so getting started is easier than ever.

entries.prefix: Kabir has over thirty years of experience
entries.to:
Dr. Marquez is a licensed clinical psychologist who has worked with anxiety, depression and life transitions for more than 18 years. Before opening Harbor Mind she led an outpatient counseling team at a Miami community clinic, where she saw first-hand how long people waited for care.

She holds a PsyD from Nova Southeastern University and still sees clients every week.

entries.prefix: Justin Gover is a seasoned biotech leader
entries.to:
Rafael is a licensed clinical social worker with 20 years in community mental health and substance use recovery. He advises our team on care coordination and on connecting clients with support beyond the therapy room.

He holds an MSW from Florida International University.

entries.prefix: Dr. Jonas has held executive leadership roles
entries.to:
Dr. Raman is a board-certified psychiatrist who works alongside our therapists when a client may benefit from a medication evaluation. She focuses on mood and anxiety disorders and on making psychiatric care feel collaborative.

She completed her psychiatry residency at the University of Miami.

entries.prefix: Daphne brings over 20 years of leadership
entries.to:
Lauren is a licensed marriage and family therapist and a certified Gottman therapist. She supervises our couples program and trains new clinicians in relationship-focused care.

She has practiced in South Florida for 15 years.

entries.prefix: Bob has more than 35 years of experience
entries.to:
Dr. Brooks is a clinical psychologist and researcher who studies how people stay with therapy long enough for it to help. He guides the short progress check-ins every Harbor Mind client can use.

He has taught graduate courses in cognitive behavioral therapy for over a decade.

entries.prefix: David brings decades of leadership experience
entries.to:
Carmen is a licensed mental health counselor who specializes in grief, loss and caregiver stress. She leads our grief groups and advises on care for families going through hard seasons together.

She provides therapy in English and Spanish.

entries.prefix: Wayne J Riley, MD, MPH, MBA is a physician executive
entries.to:
Dr. Baptiste is a licensed psychologist and certified EMDR consultant. He supervises our trauma program and makes sure every trauma-focused plan moves at a pace the client can trust.

He trained at the Florida Institute of Technology and speaks English, French and Haitian Creole.

entries.prefix: Kathleen brings over 20 years of biopharma experience
entries.to:
Mei Lin is a licensed clinical social worker who works with teens, young adults and their parents. She advises our teen program on school stress, social anxiety and building skills that last.

She has worked in Miami-Dade schools and private practice for 12 years.

entries.prefix: Each of us came to Compass for reasons
entries.to: Each of us came to this work for reasons rooted in our own lives. What we share is a belief that therapy should feel human, and a commitment to showing up for you every single week.

entries.prefix: We don't have a values statement
entries.to: We don’t have a values statement on a wall. We have a way of working that every therapist here shares, built around one idea: you should feel safe, heard and never rushed.

entries.prefix: We know exactly where we’re headed
entries.to: Every plan starts with your story, not a checklist. We take time to understand what you’re carrying before we suggest a way forward.

entries.prefix: We are united, supporting one another
entries.to: Therapy works best as a partnership. You set the pace, we bring the tools, and we adjust the plan with you along the way.

entries.prefix: We prioritize integrity, rigor and a disciplined
entries.to: We use methods with decades of research behind them, protect your privacy, and stay honest about progress, even when it’s slow.

entries.prefix: We’re leading the way, creating a brand-new category
entries.to: Our clinicians train every year in new approaches and meet weekly to talk through cases, so you get the benefit of the whole team.

Dr. Okafor is a licensed clinical psychologist with more than 25 years of experience treating anxiety and mood disorders. She chairs our clinical advisors and leads the monthly case consultations every Harbor Mind therapist attends.

She trained at the University of Miami and has supervised doctoral interns in South Florida for over a decade.
